item.title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits

turns.text: Can you make a silent 5-second widescreen video of a waterfall in 4K on the free tier? Don't generate yet—just tell me whether that's possible and what resolution you can actually make for free.

item.tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

answer_sheet.Requested video: A silent 5-second widescreen waterfall video in 4K.
answer_sheet.Budget or upgrade: Free tier only; no paid upgrade authorized.
answer_sheet.Immediate action: Explain feasibility and the available free resolution; do not generate yet.
answer_sheet.Accepting a lower-resolution version: Not yet decided; only explain the available option now.

must_haves: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.

turns.text: Can you make a silent 5-second widescreen video of a waterfall in 4K on the free tier? Don't generate yet—just tell me whether that's possible and what resolution you can actually make for free.

dialog.agent:
**Not in 4K, no. On the free plan, the highest you can get is 480p.** Everything else you asked for works.

| Requirement | On the free plan |
|---|---|
| **4K** | ❌ Not possible. Free video models only go up to **480p** (about 854×480 in 16:9). The models that can make 4K need a paid plan, and so does the video upscaler (720p, 1080p, 2K and 4K). |
| **5 seconds** | ✅ Fine. The free models allow up to 30 or 60 seconds. |
| **Widescreen (16:9)** | ✅ Supported. |
| **Silent** | ✅ Audio is off by default, and I'd also turn it off explicitly. |

**What I can make for free:** a 5-second, 16:9, silent waterfall video at **480p**. I'd use one of the two free models:
- **ltx-2.5** (the free plan's default)
- **minimax-h3**

**If you need 4K:** you'd need to upgrade to a paid plan. Then you could either generate in 4K directly, or make a lower-resolution video and upscale it to 4K.

Do you want me to go ahead with the free 480p version? If you have a particular look in mind, like a lush jungle, an icy mountain falls or a slow drone shot, tell me and I'll put it in the prompt.
dialog.why: It explains that 4K needs a paid plan, offers a free 480p alternative, and ends by asking whether to go ahead with that version. The reply waits on a confirmation to proceed. The request for scene details is optional.
dialog.user: Thanks, that answers it. I haven't decided yet whether 480p will work for me, so please don't generate anything for now. The look is your call if I go ahead.

dialog.agent:
Sounds good. I won't generate anything until you tell me to.

If you go ahead, I'll make the free 480p version (5 seconds, 16:9, silent) and pick a look that suits a waterfall.
dialog.why: The assistant describes what it would make and waits for the user's go-ahead before generating.
dialog.user: Great, thanks. I'll let you know if I decide to go ahead.

turns.agent: Sounds good. Just let me know if you want the 480p version.
